questions.question: Shark, Torpedo (Electric ray) and Trygon (Sting ray) are fishes and belong to class:-
questions.explanation:
Solution/Explanation/Calculation:
Chondrichthyes is a class of cartilaginous fish, which includes species like sharks, rays, and skates. These animals are characterized by having a skeleton made of cartilage rather than bone, which gives them a more flexible and lightweight structure compared to bony fish (Osteichthyes).
Examples of Chondrichthyes:
1. Sharks
○ Great White Shark (Carcharodon carcharias)
○ Hammerhead Shark (Sphyrna spp.)
○ Tiger Shark (Galeocerdo cuvier)
2. Rays
○ Manta Ray (Manta birostris)
○ Stingray (Dasyatidae family)
3. Skates
○ Common Skate (Dipturus batis)
These species share common features like a cartilaginous skeleton, gill slits (often five to seven), and usually a well-developed sense of smell and lateral line system, which helps them detect vibrations in the water. Most Chondrichthyes are carnivorous, and some, like rays, may also filter-feed.

questions.question: Na+/K+ pump is an example of :-
questions.explanation:
Explanation:
The Na+/K+ pump is an example of active transport because it requires energy (in the form of ATP) to move sodium (Na+) ions out of the cell and potassium (K+) ions into the cell against their concentration gradients.

questions.question: Which one of the following is not a component of cell wall of algae :
questions.explanation:
Explanation:
The cell wall of algae is primarily composed of cellulose, galactans (such as agar and carrageenan), and mannans. Hemicellulose is not typically a major component of algal cell walls; it is more commonly found in the cell walls of higher plants.
